name: synthesized-terminal-envelope
description: warren-9a4a: the in-pod agent entrypoint synthesizes a terminal agent_end envelope when the agent exits without one (isTerminalEnvelope tracks parsed events via src/core/event-envelope.ts extractAgentEventEnvelope; emitSynthesizedTerminalEnvelope emits post-exit with stopReason error on non-zero exit). Reap terminalizes ONLY on result|agent_end on the state_change/system carrier, so any new in-pod kill path must leave a terminal envelope behind or the run hangs in running.

name: k8s-salvage-window
description: K8s in-pod salvage (src/runtime/k8s/salvage.ts) commits a dirty tree with the bot identity BEFORE push/bundle captures, and the agent container carries WARREN_GIT_TOKEN harness-only: defaultSpawn scrubs it via agentChildEnv (agent-io.ts), finalize-entrypoint falls back to it in no_intent windows. FinalizeGitRunner opts.env supports undefined=delete for the GIT_* repo-context scrub.

name: salvage-trigger-decision
description: warren-985e: pod-side salvage triggers are decided by salvageTriggerForResult() in src/runtime/k8s/salvage-post.ts over the collected FinalizeResult (push_failed | empty_push_dirty); a SUCCESSFUL zero-commit push with a dirty tree is a loss window too — the pushed branch carries nothing. New wire enums go in src/core/wire.ts, which sits exactly at its frozen check:size budget, so adding vocabulary requires condensing comments elsewhere in the file.

name: pod-driven-finalize-recovery
description: warren-5202: control-plane-restart recovery for in-pod finalize is POD-DRIVEN, not sweep-driven — the pod's own GET /runs/:id/finalize-intent poll is the only signal that survives every restart shape (log rotation can erase the terminal envelope, and the agent+finalize share one container so pod status can't distinguish 'agent running' from 'awaiting intent'). Pattern: handler reports intent misses to a boot-wired FinalizeRecoveryHook (src/runs/finalize-recovery.ts); grace + single-flight + coordinator re-check prevent racing the healthy reap path; outcome classified from a new ?agent_exit= poll hint, then the persisted event log, then a succeeded default. Terminal/gone pods stay with the warren-c433 watchdog reconcile net.
